'''Gil Cassel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] born on [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]] to a pro-[[Fel Empire|Imperial]] family. He was the brother of [[Jared Cassel]], who, like Gil, joined the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|There are some things more important than duty.&hellip; than life&hellip;''"<br />"''Then let ''both'' of you die as ''traitors''!|Gil Cassel and Darth Maleval|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 4" />}}
Gil Cassel was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]] whose family was pro-[[Fel Empire|Imperial]]. He and his brother, [[Jared Cassel]], both joined the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] under [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]]. After [[Darth Krayt]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], seized the Imperial throne, Gil Cassel remained loyal to the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial faction]] while his brother defected to Fel's [[Empire-in-exile]].<ref name="Legacy (2006) 4" />

[[File:Gil_Cassel.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Gil Cassel.]]
By [[137 ABY]], Cassel had reached the rank [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] and served in the [[407th Stormtrooper Division]], which was stationed in [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]]. Meanwhile, his brother served in the [[908th Stormtrooper Division]] and held the rank of [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. As part of the [[Second Imperial Civil War]] and as a result of the 908th's defection, the 407th was sent to [[Borosk/Legends|Borosk]] to eliminate the 908th. Despite the presence of his brother in the enemy's side, Gil nonetheless led his troops in [[Battle of Borosk (137 ABY)|battle]].<ref name="Legacy (2006) 4" />

In the midst of the battle, with the 407th already winning ground to the 908th, Cassel and [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Ran Harkas]] of [[Joker Squad]], discussed the possibility of offering the defecting 908th a chance to surrender. However, [[Darth Maleval]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] overseeing the 407th on behalf of Emperor Krayt, refused the plan and ordered the complete eradication of the 908th. Despite objections from [[Jes Gistang]] and [[Hondo Karr]], both members of Joker Squad, Lieutenant Cassel chose to follow Lord Maleval's orders.<ref name="Legacy (2006) 4" />

After the 407th's victory, [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Maleval brought the captured Jared Cassel to be executed by Gil as a test of his loyalty to the Sith Empire. However. Gil refused to kill his own brother, for which both were decapitated by the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] Sith Lord.<ref name="Legacy (2006) 4" />

==Personality and traits==
Gil Cassel had [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and a light skin tone.<ref name="Legacy (2006) 4" />
